verdict: UNSURE(the page name is the defect, not the screens)
finding: The page whose name asserts 'code-canonical' is the one that CONTRADICTS the code's nav SSOT; page 988:2, which claims only to be 'v2 — screens', matches it exactly.
evidence: nav.ts NAV_GROUPS = Home, Getting started, Sites, Agency(agencyOnly), Media, Settings; ECOSYSTEM_NAV = Marketplace, Learn, Resources, Templates rendered full-width in the TOP nav. 988:3 draws exactly that (top nav 5 tabs + sidebar 5 visible items + workspace switcher). Spine 853:209 draws sidebar = Home, Sites, Templates, Media, Notifications + a 'WORKSPACE' group (Members, Billing, Settings) and NO top nav — an IA nav.ts does not contain. settings-sections.ts = 14 sections in 6 groups; 993:360 renders 14 cards in 6 groups with the descriptions verbatim; the spine has no Settings directory at all.
recommend: Rename 397:2 to drop 'code-canonical' (e.g. 'Dashboard — spine (pre-IA-v2, retain until drained)') and mark 988:2 as the canonical dashboard page. Never delete 397:2 — see D-L-03.

finding: 115 product screens are designed across two pages and 22 of the spine's 33 screens have a v2 counterpart designing the same job with a different IA — the largest duplication in the file.
evidence: 397:2 = 54 children (34 FRAME: 33 product screens + 1 handoff note 848:215; 20 TEXT: 14 captions + 6 section headers). 988:2 = 175 children (82 FRAME, 93 TEXT: 79 captions + 14 section headers). Duplicate pairs (spine→v2): Home 853:209→988:3; Sites list 398:14→997:1923; Sites empty 869:375→1000:2016; Site detail 398:3809→991:203; Media 853:411→1023:5205; Templates 853:505→1024:5519; Getting started 853:317→1028:5734; Members 398:3868→1008:3292; Billing 398:3965→1008:3466; Workspace settings 398:4015→1010:3519; Notifications 398:4114→1023:5568; sign-in 397:3→1016:5192; session-expired 397:50→1018:5192; path chooser 398:97→1032:6281; template pick 853:533→1025:5844+1025:5870; onboarding workspace 853:7227→1018:5264; first site 853:7243→1032:6302+1031:5840; AI brief 853:7259→1025:5734+1025:5768+1025:5806; AI generating 853:7275→1032:6315; ready 853:7307→1032:6339; 2FA 853:7148→1016:5270; Sites new 869:375→1031:5840.

finding: The spine is the ONLY record in the entire file for 11 jobs, 8 of them real shipping routes — so retiring the page as 'superseded' would delete design coverage, not duplication.
evidence: Name sweep across all 11 pages of g4GzQFqzNYz5sosz1QtZXC returned a single hit each for: 397:18 Auth · sign-up (/auth/signup), 397:38 Auth · forgot-password (/auth/forgot-password), 853:7116 Auth · check inbox (/auth/check-inbox), 853:7132 Auth · verify email (/auth/verify-email), 853:7164 Auth · magic link sent (/auth/magic-link/sent), 853:7180 Auth · workspace select (/auth/workspace-select), 853:7148 Auth · 2FA (/auth/2fa — v2 has only /auth/2fa/backup at 1016:5270), 853:7291 Onboarding · AI · preview (/onboarding/ai/preview — page.tsx exists), 869:508 Onboarding · AI · generation-failed, 869:468 Dashboard · Media · empty, 398:4164 Account · sign out. Also spine-only: sign-in sub-states 448:3899 (submitting) and 448:3919 (invalid-credentials) — 1016:5192 has no sub-states. All 8 routes confirmed present in packages/dashboard/app.

finding: Two different designs for the same route /dashboard/sites/[id]/access sit on the SAME page 988:2; the newer trio (1731:*) matches the shipping component verbatim and the older captioned one (1006:3128) does not.
evidence: access-tab.tsx:110 title="Share Links" (Title Case) and :116 the two-line body copy 'Share links control who you hand the URL to. To actually restrict who can open a published site, set a published-site password in Settings — that is enforced on the live URL by the host.' — both reproduced word-for-word in 1731:6357 and absent from 1006:3128 (which says 'Share links' / 'Private preview links — no account needed to open one.'). access-tab.tsx:170 renders {link.viewCount} views per row — 1731:6357 shows '12 views'; 1006:3128 shows none. finding: The three newest v2 frames are the only ones on the page with no caption, and the page's own section-header counts were never updated for them.
evidence: 79 of 82 frames on 988:2 carry a sibling 'caption/…' TEXT node; 1731:6357, 1731:6535 and 1731:6731 carry none. Section headers 1054:13366-13379 total 1+15+16+1+4+10+32 = 79, against 82 actual frames — the difference is exactly this trio.

finding: The spine's board for the product's most important object contradicts the shipping tab contract on count, labels and control pattern — five stacked accordion rows where the code has an eight-tab rail.
evidence: tab-nav.tsx SITE_DETAIL_TABS = Overview, Traffic, Domains, SEO, Submissions, Redirects, Sharing, Settings (8). 398:3809 draws 5 accordion rows: Domains, SEO, 'Publish history', 'Feedback & reviews', 'Access'. Three of the five labels are not tab labels in code ('Publish history' has no tab; 'Feedback & reviews' is 'Submissions'; 'Access' is the segment, the label is 'Sharing'), and Overview, Traffic, Redirects and Settings are absent entirely. 991:203 draws the correct 8-tab rail (visible in 1006:3128 and 1731:6357) and its caption cites tab-nav.tsx.
recommend: Retire 398:3809 in favour of 991:203; it is the clearest single proof that 397:2 is not code-canonical.

finding: The spine's shell — reproduced on all 20 of its in-app screens — puts two ecosystem/notification destinations in the workspace sidebar and promotes two settings sub-pages to top-level siblings, none of which nav.ts allows.
evidence: 853:209 sidebar: Home, Sites, Templates, Media, Notifications + 'WORKSPACE' group Members, Billing, Settings. nav.ts NAV_GROUPS has no Templates (it is in ECOSYSTEM_NAV, full-width, isFullWidthRoute) and no Notifications; Members and Billing are /dashboard/settings/team and /dashboard/settings/billing, reached through the Settings directory per settings-sections.ts. nav.ts also has Getting started and Agency, which the spine shell omits. The spine shell has no top nav, no workspace switcher, no search and no storage meter — all four present in 988:3.
recommend: No fix on the spine; this is the systemic reason its 20 in-app screens are superseded by 988:2 wholesale rather than screen by screen.

finding: The superseded Sharing board invents two things the data model does not have — a per-link status badge and a site-level QR panel — and one of its two badge words is borrowed from domain verification.
evidence: prisma/schema.prisma:689 model ShareLink = id, siteId, name, token, passwordHash, expiresAt, viewCount, isActive, createdAt — no status enum. 1006:3128 renders 'Live' and 'Verifying' badges per row; 'Verifying' is domain-verification vocabulary (the dns-verify cron / Site · Domains board), not a share-link state. 1006:3128 also draws a standalone 'QR code / Scan to open the live site' card; in access-tab.tsx:177 QR is a per-row toggle button (title="QR Code", aria-label="Show QR code") with no site-level panel. siteDetail.sharing exposes list/create/revoke only.
recommend: Fold into 1731:6357 (which has the per-row QR icon); do not carry the status badges or the QR card forward.

finding: The spine collapses three real routes into one screen and then labels it 'step 1 of 3' with no step 2 or 3 in the file, so the prototype promises a wizard it cannot walk.
evidence: Routes /onboarding/ai/basics, /onboarding/ai/goal and /onboarding/ai/brand all exist as page.tsx. 853:7259 is a single card titled 'Describe the business — step 1 of 3' with one field and a 'Generate draft' CTA, and its only outbound reaction goes to 853:7275 (AI generating) — it skips the two steps it names. v2 splits them correctly: 1025:5734 basics → 1025:5768 goal → 1025:5806 brand → 1032:6315 generating, with a 1-2-3 stepper and a 'Continue' CTA. v2 caption 1025:5902 states the reason: 'a REAL step; the old spine collapsed basics+goal+brand into one brief frame'.
recommend: Retire 853:7259. Separately on that board, the H1 and the field label both read 'Describe the business', and a step-1-of-3 CTA should read Continue, not Generate draft.

finding: The Danger-zone card is one code revision behind, on the exact wording the code carries a comment explaining it changed.
evidence: 993:360 renders 'Delete workspace' / 'Permanently remove this workspace'; frame 1014:5231 is named 'Settings · Delete workspace'. settings-sections.ts ships { label: 'Delete workspace or account', description: 'Permanent, and not reversible' } with the comment: 'Named for both halves of the page it opens. The other 13 cards match settings-sections.ts verbatim.
recommend: Update the card to 'Delete workspace or account' / 'Permanent, and not reversible' and rename frame 1014:5231 to match.

finding: The spine's Members board shows four bare names against a router with twelve procedures — no role, no status, no seat count, no per-row action, no invite state.

screen: Six auth routes with no board anywhere in the file

All six exist as page.tsx: /auth/access-removed, /auth/account-unlocked, /auth/email-exists, /auth/join-workspace, /auth/oauth-conflict, /auth/password-changed. finding: Both pages are fully wired prototypes and not one reaction crosses between them, so a walker entering either dashboard can never reach the other — two complete, mutually invisible products.
evidence: Reactions sweep over all 34 spine frames and all 82 v2 frames (carriers = frame + descendants). Every spine frame has 1-11 outbound destinations and every destination id is in the 397/398/448/848/853/869 range. Every v2 frame has 1-26 outbound destinations and every destination id is in the 988+ range. Zero cross-page edges in either direction. The spine's only external edge is 848:215 'Handoff → Editor (S1 · 52:2 on 🖥️ Editor)', a 761x204 annotation frame, not a screen.

finding: The confirmation copy sits below the primary button, so the user reads the headline, crosses ~90px of empty card, presses a CTA, and only then learns which address was mailed — and there is no resend and no way to correct a wrong address.
evidence: 853:7116: H1 'Check your inbox' at the card top, then blank space, then the primary 'Open email app' button, then 'We sent a sign-in link to sara@vortexstudio.co' as the last line. No resend control, no 'wrong email?' link, no expiry statement. Route /auth/check-inbox exists; this is the file's only board for it (D-L-03) and its sibling stubs 853:7132 verify email, 853:7164 magic link sent and 853:7180 workspace select share the 2-child structure.
recommend: When rebuilding on 988:2, put the address line directly under the H1, add resend with a cooldown and a 'use a different email' escape, and state the link's lifetime.

finding: The sidebar shows a Sites badge of 6 on the screen that tells the user they cannot see those sites.
evidence: 1000:2352 renders 'You don't have access to these sites / You're scoped to specific sites. Ask a workspace admin to widen your access.' while the sidebar Sites row carries the badge '6' — the same badge value as the fully-permitted 988:3 and 997:1923. Caption 1000:2518 attributes the state to resolveSiteScope throwing FORBIDDEN, i.e. the count the badge shows is one the viewer is not entitled to.
recommend: Drop the badge (or show the scoped count) in the denied and scoped states; a count the user cannot act on reads as a bug.

finding: Three breakpoint frames exist for a shell whose sidebar disappears below 1024 on every screen, so 79 screens have no record of what they become on a tablet or phone.
evidence: 988:2 breakpoint frames: 1035:6242 Home 768, 1035:6347 Home 375, 1035:6434 Site · Overview 375. Caption 1035:6519 states the rule product-wide: 'sidebar is hidden below lg (1024) → mobile tab bar; stat grid drops to sm:grid-cols-2'. tab-nav.tsx confirms a second product-wide rule: the site-detail tab row is 'hidden … md:block' with a native <select> below 768. Both rules apply to every in-shell screen; only three are drawn.
recommend: Draw the mobile tab bar and the tab-row-to-select swap once as shell-level boards and annotate the rest as inheriting them, rather than leaving 79 screens desktop-only on the page.
